qualified_claims: On the identical accepted t=0 Basin state, the physical state-derived low-storage factor remains 1 while the allocation LP low_storage_factor becomes 0 under the injected infiltration case.
The physical water balance therefore realizes the full approximately 7.9999147 m3/day infiltration while the allocation forecast multiplies the same implicit negative forcing by zero.
The physical and allocation factors are distinct state semantics rather than two observations of one common reduction factor.

The DUMMY-20H3 mechanism is therefore a forecast-realization seam: physical forcing can be fully realized while the allocation forecast attenuates that forcing to protect lexicographically prior management objectives.
boundaries: No claim that the LP factor should universally equal the physical factor.
The result is qualified for the tested v2026.1.1 topology and priority structure.
